text:
sam: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem: we keep seeing restore timing variability and router flapping during cross-region spikes. Drafting consolidated action list here.

sam: Top-level actions:
- routing circuit-breaker + region ranking tweak -> owner: lina, ETA?
- snapshot manifest verification job -> owner: omar, ETA?
- runbook clarifications + time-to-restore targets -> owner: kevin, ETA?
- recurring partial restores (mini game-days) -> owner: nina, propose cadence

lina: I'll take the routing work. Plan: add a circuit-breaker to prevent thrash and move to weighted routing by health score. Need infra approval for an extra read-probe endpoint. ETA 2026-04-05.
omar: Snapshot manifest job makes sense. I'll build a lambda that verifies manifests + checksums and flags mismatches. Need S3 read role from infra. ETA 2026-03-29.
kevin: I'll update the runbook with clearer step timings and define an SLO: full restore (data + services) <= 90m in staging. Will add verification checklist. ETA 2026-03-30.
nina: Monthly cadence sounds reasonable for mini-game-days. Proposal: first Friday each month, quick partial restore of a single slice + routing failover smoke test. I'll draft a one-pager by 2026-03-25.

sam: Please create tickets with label dr-action and post links here. Also we need to track recurring incident patterns (cache warmup failures, db connection exhaustion). Add notes to runbook.

omar: Example manifest verification output:
```
OK snapshot-2026-03-20.manifest (size: 2.1GB) checksums OK
WARN snapshot-2026-03-19.manifest (size: 1.9GB) missing-chunk 7
```

lina: Circuit-breaker config draft:
```
- threshold: 10 errors/min per-route
- cooldown: 60s
- degrade-to: regional-fallback
```

kevin: Pushed runbook draft to internal repo: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/dr-restore-v2 (internal link). Added section "when to abort" and a preflight checklist.

runbook-bot: Reminder -> Add post-game metrics capture: token-latency, cache-hit-rates, active-connections.

sam: Good progress. Can everyone confirm ticket links and blockers by EOD? We'll reconvene in the weekly DR sync next Tue.

lina: Ticket created: https://jira.redwood/browse/DR-4821
omar: Ticket created: https://jira.redwood/browse/DR-4822
kevin: Ticket created: https://jira.redwood/browse/DR-4823
nina: One-pager draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/FAKE-MINI-GAMEDAY

sam: Thanks. I'll compile a brief for leadership with proposed phasing and budget for extra probe infra.

nina: Also propose we add the mini-game-day to the on-call checklist so rotations are aware.

sam: Done. Adding it to on-call runbook as a reminder step.

kevin: Noted. If we can get infra perms for the lambda this week, I can include automated verification steps in the runbook.

omar: Will ping infra owners now.

sam: Closing thread for now — keep updates in the JIRA tickets and post blockers here.
